senses.gloss: f. = צִיפָּא II, matting, mat.—[Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXXII, 9 בצ׳ ed. Vien., read: בפִיצְּתָא.]—
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 140b:3-13">Sabb. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>בר … אצ׳ חדתא וכ׳</he> a student at the school house should not sit down on new matting, because it ruins the garments.
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:1">Ned. 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>דלי לצ׳ וכ׳</he> he lifted up the mat (on which he had been sitting), and said &c.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 12b:11">Kidd. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ דאסא</he> a braid of myrtle twigs (worth less than a P’ruṭah).
<cite ref="Gittin 68a:3">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>שדו ליה צ׳ עילויה</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="R00422"><he>ציפיתא</he></cite>) they threw a mat over it (the pit).
<cite ref="Gittin 68a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ דשדיא</he> I see a map that is thrown down.
